state: Same twenty-two-year-old man; healthy through early abroad, increasingly wasted through famine.
transition: S19 changes clothing and washes feet only; thin neck, weakness and restlessness remain.
constant: Face, brown hair identity, skeletal proportions, height and defining features.

state: Same composed brown-haired twenty-nine-year-old, with growing strain.
transition: S15 memory returns to S2 physical/wardrobe state.
constant: Identity, physique, left-hand wound side, work manner.

state: Russet fine wool gift, worn then hung at lodging.
transition: Removed from peg and sold S12; never returns with younger.
constant: Same edge, weave, color and equal quality to olive mantle.

state: Olive mantle folded at gift, worn at S11 meal, delivered again S16 and held at homecoming.
transition: S20 over arm; S21 pressed to mouth then held; S22 grip loosens.
constant: Same mantle, color and quality throughout; no substitute robe.

state: Light purchased mantle with narrow blue border.
transition: Selected S9; wine-stained S10; deteriorates; bread seller refuses S13; hangs at lean-to S15; exchanged for food early S17.
constant: Never present after exchange or under best robe.

state: Original pair wears progressively.
transition: S17 strap breaks/reties, sole tears, both discarded. Barefoot to S19, then new pair.
constant: No old sandal reappears with retained bundle.

state: Requested at end S18; applied S19; retained in feast.
transition: New best robe over old dirty tunic. Plain ring on right hand. Feet washed then new sandals.
constant: No transformation into healthy groomed younger; no second inheritance imagery.

state: Split left palm receives cloth dressing; healing by S11.
transition: Cistern strain reopens S14; scar by S16 and pressed by thumb S20.
constant: Exact side/location/orientation; no fresh bleeding at feast.

state: Ordinary work tunic and sandals.
transition: S14 hides blood against tunic. S16 permanent pale cuff mend. S15 memory uses earlier costume state.
constant: Stable hem, sleeves, belt and working wear.

state: Neatly repaired seam underneath.
transition: S10 wine spill; retrieved under bench; carried through famine and return, kept with arrival belongings.
constant: Same seam, stain and strap; repair holds; no sale/discard.

state: Broken handle repaired quickly by younger S2.
transition: S14 same knot loosens; elder gathers spilled grain and remends. S15 S2 memory predates failure.
constant: Same basket dimensions, handle break and cord material.

state: Hannah’s modest bread wrapping cloth.
transition: Bread-filled departure; empty scrap found S15, folded into bundle; checked/repacked S17; retained on arrival.
constant: Same textile pattern/weave and fold damage; no food magically returns.

state: Travel bedding/clothes bundle and pouch start adequately supplied.
transition: Pouch empty after last coins; bedding survives lodging eviction, stair eviction, pig lean-to and return. Bundle set down S18.
constant: No invented forgotten silver found S15; no new luggage.

state: Visible division between both sons; money values unspecified.
transition: Bundles → excess payments → two small coins → no spendable money. Damon’s copper S13 belongs to Damon.
constant: No second inheritance at restoration; no modern currency or invented numerical wealth.

state: One retaining-wall repair, with meaningful visible progress.
transition: S2 long slump; S6 work in progress; S11 completed seating section; S16 only short upper run remains. S15 exact S2 memory.
constant: Same geology, ground, line and route to house; never reset to collapsed wall late.

state: Road visible from entrance, upper terrace above courtyard, connected cistern/store/pen.
transition: Day/night and working/feast dressing change without moving architecture.
constant: Doorpost, threshold, courtyard access, field path and table sightline.

state: Identical exposed ridge, ravine and road fork.
transition: Outward chooses broader road; return selects narrow home road.
constant: Geography, travel direction and distant town/home relationships.

state: One recognizable foreign market.
transition: Stocks deplete, portions shrink, grain store remains shut; architecture survives.
constant: Same awnings, bread stall and colonnade; no modern or later monumental city.

state: Same two carriers and pack donkey.
transition: Incoming trade bundles replaced/added with younger’s bedding at departure; separate at fork.
constant: Faces, coat marking, pack tack and number of carriers.

state: Pigs confined to foreign employer’s enclosure.
transition: Pod lifted toward mouth, dropped, taken by pig; basket left at gate at departure.
constant: No pigs on home farm; younger does not visibly consume pod.

state: Calf alive in pen at beginning of prep; cooked meat at feast.
transition: Led out; slaughter offscreen; time compressed through cooking work before meal.
constant: No live calf in continuing feast backgrounds; no instantaneous raw-to-plated cut implying zero time.

state: Father brings food bowl to wall; elder finishes meal.
transition: Same bowl carried empty down path, set beside threshold S20 and seen S21.
constant: Object shape/finish, empty state, position beside threshold.

state: Father kneels in road dust with younger and carries transferred dirt.
transition: Younger’s attempted brushing stops; same dusty clothes at restoration and personal appeal to elder.
constant: Dust locations and intensity, mantle and sleeves.

state: Preparation begins mid-afternoon; several hours compressed before dusk feast. Lamps filled at dusk; local music/dance continues into night.
transition: Elder’s place remains empty; father leaves table and crosses courtyard to him.
constant: Table seats, musician positions, doorway visibility, lamp positions and cooking chronology.

state: Ordinary silent memory fragments only.
transition: Reuse S2/S4 actors, actions, costumes, props and light.
constant: No new house, new child actors, voiceover, golden idealization or later wound/scar state.

state: Elder outside, father beside him; younger visible inside.
transition: Younger starts to rise, elder’s grip loosens; cut before any crossing or verbal decision.
constant: Doorway stays clear; no ending asset depicting elder inside celebration.

state: Late-spring stubble at opening, weeks of growing dryness and regional famine abroad.
transition: Do not show different fruit harvests ripening in one week; home remains functioning while foreign region suffers famine.
constant: No maize, tomatoes, potatoes, modern food packaging or incompatible seasonal abundance.

state: Bundle set down beside reunion on road. Subsequent pickup is not explicitly scripted.
transition: At frame planning, establish retrieval and stow before showing belongings back in courtyard.
constant: Retain bread cloth and personal belongings; do not let bundle teleport between adjacent frames.

state: New pair rests beneath washed feet during S19 restoration.
transition: At frame planning, establish sandals being put on before sustained standing/feast views.
constant: New pair only; discarded original sandals never return.
